instrument.label: DXY.cash (FTMO spot CFD)
instrument.clock_rule: the terminal stamps bars in server time; the exporter converts to UTC with the US daylight-saving dates (UTC+2 outside, UTC+3 inside) and refuses to write unless the shift reproduces against the UTC EUR/USD tape
instrument.what_it_is_not: not the ICE cash index (no official settlement print, broker hours and broker spread) and not FRED DTWEXBGS (a lagged broad trade-weighted index)
instrument.why_it_can_be_scored_here: its hourly bars are quoted continuously across both 05:00 London endpoints, so the same 05:00-to-next-05:00 question can be put to a real, named, non-official instrument
instrument.why_it_cannot_replace_the_official_serie: a broker CFD's 05:00 print is one broker's quote rather than the licensed index, so a figure from it cannot be reported as test 1's answer; the official lane stays blocked and this lane is labelled
instrument.flat_band_rule: 20th percentile of the absolute 05:00-to-05:00 move over development dates, rounded to 3 decimals

scored_window.boundary_source: .local/tmp/dxy-scan/probe_dxy_boundary.py - the instrument's D1 and H1 history and its tick tape all begin on 2024-12-10; a 2024-12-11 probe returns 1,967 two-sided ticks, probes at 2024-12-04 and earlier return none
scored_window.correction: an earlier cycle reported the tick start as 2025-01-08; that was the first sampled anchor with ticks, taken across a ten-month gap in the anchors, and the probes above supersede it
scored_window.rule: a session is scored when it starts on or after first_session and the tape prices both 05:00 London endpoints
scored_window.what_is_excluded: sessions before the instrument's first bar: the broker serves no bars and no ticks for them at all

instrument.overlay: usd_bullish_predicts=UP: a USD-bullish call predicts the dollar index rises

four_markets_usable_sessions.note: `usable_sessions` is published as 685 and quoted in docs/strategy/BACKTEST_AUDIT.md as "685 of 725 sessions priced". The committed sessions do not reproduce it: 566 carry all four outcomes and 568 carry at least three. Nothing in the artefact records the rule behind 685, so it must not be used as a denominator; the per-market counts above are the auditable figures.

reconciliation.not_meaning: mornings with a complete four-market outcome panel

reconciliation.not_meaning: a missing endpoint for BTC/USD or a missing morning for the control model

reconciliation.meaning: the DXY.cash lane's directional denominator: of 360 sessions whose two 05:00 London endpoints the broker tape prices, the control made a directional call on 284 (141 hits, 143 misses, 70 flat, 7 no-call)
reconciliation.not_meaning: a claim about the official ICE dollar index, which this lane does not use

statement: 675 is a count of mornings where the control had at least one non-flat market outcome. It is not a price count and not any market's denominator. 685 is a published label the sessions do not reproduce. The only auditable denominators are the per-market ones, and the 145 Friday rows contribute to BTC/USD only.
